Title: ServiceNow Change Request List - Build AND Filter
Description: Workflow to construct a multi-field AND filter on the Change Request list page.
- Click 'Show / hide filter' to reveal the filter panel.
- Click the field chooser combobox for the first condition to select a field.
- Select the desired field (e.g., 'Type') from the dropdown list.
- Click the value chooser combobox for the selected condition.
- Use select_option or click to set the specific value (e.g., 'Normal').
- Click 'Add AND Condition To Condition X' button to append the next filter criteria.
- Repeat the field selection, operator selection (e.g., 'is empty string'), and value entry for each new condition.
- Continue adding conditions until all criteria (Requested by, Model, Short description, State) are defined.

Title: ServiceNow Filter Panel - Interaction Details
Description: Key UI signals and behaviors observed when building filters on the Change Request list.
- The main filter panel is controlled by the 'Show / hide filter' button.
- Field choosers display the text 'All of these conditions must be met. -- choose field --' when empty.
- Value choosers display '-- None --' or similar placeholders before selection.
- If a direct click on a value option fails, the combobox may require select_option action.
- Operator selection is handled via a separate combobox (e.g., 'Operator For Condition X').
- The 'Add AND Condition' button text explicitly references the previous condition (e.g., 'Add AND Condition To Condition 1: Type is Normal').
- Empty string conditions use the 'is empty string' operator option.
- The filter logic is AND-based by default for the 'All of these conditions must be met' group.
